description:
You do not want to miss this beautiful total remodeled single family home. Small but absolute charming with all contemporary features. Tucked away at the rear of the property for ultimate privacy, this beautifully reimagined detached cottage offers a rare oasis in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods, this hidden gem combines modern luxury with serene outdoor living.    Thoughtfully remodeled from top to bottom . The home features three spacious bedrooms and three full bathrooms across two levels. Every detail has been updated, including new electrical systems, a new furnace, designer bathrooms, and a stunning kitchen equipped with brand-new appliances.    The true showpiece is the spectacular professionally landscaped backyard. Lush gardens, inviting gathering spaces, and mature plantings create a private retreat so captivating that it rivals the beauty of the home itself.
Perfectly positioned just approximately 40 feet from Geary Blvd.,  residents enjoy unparalleled access to public transportation with convenient service to down San Francisco, the Financial District, and beyond.  Daily convenience are right at your doorstep, including Grocery Outlet just a block away, along with an abundance of neighborhood restaurants, cafes, bakeries, and local shops all within easy walking distance.   This  cottage offers the perfect blend of privacy, modern comfort, and an unbeatable Richmond District lifestyle.

Welcome home to this bright and spacious top-floor 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment in one of San Francisco’s most desirable neighborhoods. Filled with natural light and thoughtfully updated throughout, this inviting home offers generous living spaces, an updated kitchen with dishwasher, and the convenience of one-car parking.
The open living and dining area creates an ideal space for both everyday living and entertaining. The updated kitchen features crisp cabinetry, stone countertops, modern appliances, and a dishwasher, with a dedicated dining area just beyond the kitchen.
The spacious primary bedroom is comfortably sized for a king-size bed, nightstands, and additional furnishings, while the two additional bedrooms can easily accommodate queen-size beds and home office or storage furniture. The thoughtful floor plan gives the primary bedroom and one bathroom their own private wing, separated from the additional bedrooms by the central living area.
Both bathrooms retain the building’s charming vintage character while offering practical layouts. One features a walk-in shower, while the other offers a shower/tub combination. Skylights bring an abundance of natural light into both spaces.
Additional features include newer flooring in the living areas, brand-new bedroom carpeting, double-paned windows throughout, and one-car parking.
An Exceptional Richmond District Location!
This home puts the best of San Francisco’s Richmond District, Golden Gate Park, and Pacific Ocean coastline right outside your door. The neighborhood offers an incredible mix of outdoor recreation, local restaurants, coffee shops, markets, and everyday conveniences—all within easy walking distance.
Spend the morning exploring Golden Gate Park, grab coffee and breakfast along Clement Street, or head west for an afternoon at Baker Beach or Lands End. The neighborhood’s proximity to some of San Francisco’s most spectacular parks, trails, beaches, and scenic overlooks makes this an especially appealing location for anyone who enjoys an active, outdoors-oriented lifestyle.
Bright, spacious, updated, and exceptionally well located—355 24th Avenue #302 is a wonderful place to call home.

Welcome to 2114 35th Avenue, a beautifully and completely renovated home offering modern finishes.
This spacious residence features 3 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms. The newly remodeled kitchen is equipped with brand-new stainless-steel appliances, custom-made cabinetry offering generous storage, elegant quartz countertops, and updated fixtures. The open and functional kitchen layout provides plenty of preparation space and is ideal for everyday cooking, entertaining, and gathering with family and friends.
Additional upgrades include new engineered wood flooring, new windows, fresh interior finishes, and an in-unit washer and dryer for added convenience. The renovated bathrooms feature clean, modern finishes designed for both comfort and practicality.
The garage can accommodate up to two vehicles and provides direct access to the basement and backyard. Residents will also enjoy full access to the backyard, providing valuable outdoor space for relaxation, gardening, or entertaining.
Tenants are responsible for all utilities.
